info.title: Seamnex API
info.description: Seamnex — self-hosted FOSS domain platform. Generated from packages/domain/src/contract.ts. Authorization is deny-by-default against the §5.2 capability matrix; every denied request writes an access.denied audit record. Long operations answer 202 and are polled through the returned job link, or streamed through /jobs/{id}/stream.
